RULING = (a) TEST-FIDELITY, not (b) data-quality; fix TEST-ONLY (no production write-path change). The 'no two rows share (second-timestamp, parameter)' invariant is FALSE by design: realtime_data.timestamp is canonical SECOND-resolution ISO-8601 (utcIsoNow strftime %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ + SQLite DEFAULT, TD-027/US-202) and poll cadence is 2 Hz, so two DISTINCT samples legitimately share a second; schema's ONLY unique key is id AUTOINCREMENT, NO UNIQUE(timestamp,parameter_name) -> multi-sample-per-second is permitted by the data model. Old test was machine-speed-dependent (passed slow box / failed fast box ~185 'dups') = test-fidelity smell. RULED OUT (b): compute_drive_statistics + basic._collectReadings/collectReadingsForDrive both flatten ALL rows-per-param into a value list for min/max/avg/std -- NO GROUP BY timestamp / DISTINCT timestamp anywhere -> extra samples = correct sampling, never double-count.
